intent.description: Governed setup, audit, repair, and end-to-end verification of Supabase Google Auth for a web project. Use when Nemo asks to create or reuse the exact Google Cloud project and OAuth Web application, configure Google Auth Platform branding/audience/scopes, enable the Supabase Google provider, set Site URL and Redirect URLs, implement or validate a PKCE callback with exchangeCodeForSession, or prove a real Google sign-in and protected session. Also use for redirect_uri_mismatch, provider-disabled, callback, or login-loop diagnosis in a Supabase Google OAuth flow. Prefer a compatible existing project/client over duplicates. Do not trigger for generic Supabase database work, non-Google identity providers, unrelated Google APIs, explanation-only OAuth questions, pentesting, or any request to paste or export credentials.
intent.job_to_be_done: Configure, audit, repair, and prove a Supabase Google Auth flow across the exact application, Google Cloud project and OAuth Web client, Supabase provider and redirect configuration, and a real protected browser session without exposing credentials or personal identity data.
inputs: project directory, environment, application origins, callback route, and protected success signal
exact Supabase organization and project alias
exact Google account or organization and existing-or-new project decision
Google audience and testing versus production status
separate authorization for code, Google, Supabase, and real-login actions
outputs: audited existing-resource inventory and reuse decision
exact Google and Supabase URL matrix
per-action authorization, before snapshot, execution, readback, and rollback ledger
redacted configuration-ready and end-to-end evidence report
exclusions: non-Google identity providers or unrelated Google APIs
database schema, RLS, user migration, account linking, or MFA
credential extraction, browser-storage inspection, or auth pentesting
automatic OAuth app publication, billing, resource deletion, or Git push

compact_workflow: **建立脱敏基线。** 记录 Git revision/dirty state、auth SDK/SSR helpers、登录入口、callback route、protected route、环境、现有 provider/client 数量与每个动作的 before snapshot。只记录别名、状态和证据 pointer，不记录用户或凭证数据。
**审计与复用。** 在精确 Google account/organization 下查找与当前应用对应的 project 和 Web client；在 Supabase 查 Google provider、Site URL 与 redirect allowlist。名称相近但归属或 callback 不一致时标为冲突，不猜测、不重复创建。

**验证代码路径。** 确认 `signInWithOAuth({ provider: 'google', options: { redirectTo } })` 使用 URL matrix 中的应用 callback。PKCE/SSR callback 必须读取一次性 `code`、调用 `exchangeCodeForSession(code)`、处理失败，并在服务器端用可信的 `getUser()` 或等价当前官方方法验证用户。
**封闭 `next`。** `next` 只能是以单个 `/` 开头的站内相对路径；拒绝 `//host`、绝对 URL、反斜杠和编码后可逃逸的值。默认回到固定安全页面。

**配置 Google Auth。** 精确确认 project 后，只设置完成登录所需的 branding、audience 和 `openid`、email、profile scopes。External Testing 的测试用户由用户在 provider UI 直接选择；不记录邮箱。不要顺带启用无关 Google API、offline access、billing 或 Production publication。
**创建或更新 Web client。** client type 必须是 Web application。先保存现有 origins/redirects 快照，再做一个最小变更并回读。Client ID 可作为 provider 标识使用；Client secret 由用户直接从 Google UI 填到 Supabase UI，agent 不复制、不回显、不截图。
**配置 Supabase。** 在精确 project 启用 Google provider，写入 client ID 和用户直接输入的 secret；再单独配置 Site URL 与 Redirect URLs。Provider enable 与 URL allowlist 是两个 mutation，分别回读。
**运行真实登录。** 先告知该步骤可能产生 Google consent grant、Supabase user 和 session。只有授权后才在真实浏览器执行；不检查 Cookie/localStorage。登录完成后验证 callback chain、最终站内 URL、服务端用户信号与一个受保护页面。
**收尾。** 登出测试会话；如用户要求撤销 consent、删除测试用户或删除多余 OAuth client，把每项作为新的 destructive mutation 单独授权。默认保留成功配置，不自动清理真实用户或 provider 资源。

execution.shell: project-native commands, bundled report validator, Supabase tools, and governed browser interaction

trust.source_tier: local governed package; mutable Supabase and Google behavior requires current official or live-provider evidence
trust.credential_policy: credential and personal identity values never enter prompts, reports, fixtures, command output, screenshots, source, or shell persistence

permissions.network: only exact Supabase, Google Auth Platform, application, and official documentation resources in the locked scope
permissions.file_write: only exact authorized application auth files and an explicit redacted OAuth report
permissions.subprocess: project-native checks plus bundled validators; no credential-bearing command arguments
permissions.live_mutation: only separately authorized Google project, Auth configuration, Web client, Supabase provider, URL configuration, and real-login actions
permissions.interactive: allowed for provider UI and consent; the user directly enters credential values and personal test-account selections

degradation.ambiguous_identity_or_project: continue read-only discovery; do not create or mutate resources
degradation.no_google_write_access: produce a reuse audit, exact URL matrix, code checks, mutation plan, and missing-evidence report
degradation.no_supabase_write_access: leave provider and URL actions pending with exact handoff and rollback plan
degradation.no_browser_or_real_login_authorization: cap the claim at configuration_ready and record provider-backed login as missing evidence
degradation.no_current_google_docs: use current Supabase official guidance plus live provider readback, record missing evidence, and avoid fixed UI claims

governed: exact account, organization, project, environment, origins, and callback route are locked before mutation
compatible existing Google project and OAuth client are audited before any duplicate is created
application code and each Google, Supabase, and real-login action have separate authorization and readback
Google redirect URI is the Supabase provider callback while Supabase redirect URLs are application callbacks
PKCE callback exchanges the code once and next remains a safe relative application path
Google scopes stay at openid, email, and profile unless separately authorized
credential, OAuth code, token, Cookie, session ID, email, user ID, and browser storage are prohibited evidence
real login is announced as a consent, user, and session mutation before execution
configuration_ready requires code, URL matrix, Google readback, and Supabase readback
end_to_end_verified additionally requires callback, trusted user, protected route, and logout-negative evidence
provider-backed or human-review evidence remains missing until actually recorded

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
